q1_issues.issue: The finite "will" is dropped -- the consequent carries no (Future (sk_feed $x)) status atom, so a future claim is recorded as a tenseless habitual.

q2_gaps: a future-tense ("will") claim over a bare mass/kind subject: the distributing-rule route is specified for genuinely generic clauses (habitual present, characteristic claim), and the instruction set does not say whether a "will" generic takes the rule at all, nor whether Future rides its consequent
notes: Compound handling is right (mire_essence/lantern_lighting genus only, no noun-modifier genus) and the "stored" restriction correctly becomes a premise conjunct rather than fusing into the kind. Patient on "feed" is arguable but defensible.
